headline: India's HPCL Faces Tanker Shortages for Gulf Oil Shipments Amid Hormuz Risks
summary: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited is struggling to hire tankers to transit the Strait of Hormuz and pick up crude cargoes in the Gulf due to scarce vessel availability and last-minute decisions, despite recovering oil flows.
why: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited is a major Indian state-owned refiner. Disruptions in tanker availability and transit through key chokepoints like the Strait of Hormuz can impact refinery feedstock costs and regional energy supply chains.

impacts.name: Hindustan Petroleum Corp Ltd
impacts.why: As the primary subject, HPCL faces operational difficulties in securing oil tankers for transit through the Strait of Hormuz.
